# ankra_datasource_credential (Resource)

A data source credential (`ankra credentials datasource create`): the user name and password, or token, a cluster's metrics or log source authenticates to its backend with, referenced by name from the cluster's `spec.prometheus_metrics` or `spec.log_source`. The password and token are write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later): they go to the platform's secret store and never reach plan or state. The platform has no update for this credential, so any change, including a new `secret_wo_version`, replaces it; the platform refuses to delete a credential a cluster still uses. Needs `credentials.read` and `credentials.write` (and `credentials.delete` to destroy).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Terraform 1.11 or later: the password is write-only and never stored in
# state. Bump secret_wo_version to store a new one.
resource "ankra_datasource_credential" "mimir" {
  name              = "mimir-reader"
  auth_scheme       = "basic"
  username          = "reader"
  password_wo       = var.mimir_password
  secret_wo_version = 1
}

variable "mimir_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name the metrics or log source references. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_scheme` (String) How the backend is authenticated to, such as `basic` or `bearer`. The platform does not return it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Changing it replaces the credential. Right after an import the configured value is recorded instead.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of basic authentication, as a write-only attribute.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Version of `password_wo` and `token_wo`. Terraform cannot see a change to a write-only value, so change this to store a new one; that replaces the credential. Right after an import the configured version is recorded without sending a secret.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Bearer token, as a write-only attribute.
- `username` (String) User name of basic authentication. The platform does not return it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Changing it replaces the credential. Right after an import the configured value is recorded instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by credential id. The secret, user name and scheme are never read back.
terraform import ankra_datasource_credential.mimir 3b4c5d6e-7f80-4911-8a2b-3c4d5e6f7a8b
```
